quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I haven't seen or heard anything about Benji Dillon's visit to Dimond Pharmacy, but I'm always interested in what's going on in our city's neighborhoods, even if it's not directly in my Temescal community.

quotes.name: Rick Walker
quotes.quote: I haven't seen Benji Dillon around my neighborhood, but I've heard he was spotted at Dimond Pharmacy, which is a bit of a trek from Fruitvale where I live and work as a line cook.
